offset_lattice_convention.determinism: the offset lattice is declared in whole cells and applied identically at every level; no fractional-cell offsets, no out_alpha reweighting, no source-stencil move, and no boundary/grid/constants change is permitted
offset_lattice_convention.fail_closed_gates: a moved cell is only executable iff every moved out_ixyz node is inside the grid, no moved node sits on an outer absorbing-layer plane (any axis index 0 or N-1), and every moved node is air-connected under the frozen six-neighbor cartesian BFS of the canonical boundary representation; a cell that fails any gate blocks the diagnostic as fail-closed (ValidationBlocked)
offset_lattice_convention.moved_position_rule: the moved stencil is the trilinear stencil of the moved exact position p' = receiver_position_m + offset_cells*h on that level's own grid; for whole-cell offsets this is exactly the canonical eight-node out_ixyz set rigidly translated by the offset vector with the canonical trilinear out_alpha weight row unchanged
offset_lattice_convention.units: whole grid cells on the level's own uniform cartesian grid; an offset (kx,ky,kz) moves the receiver exact position by (kx*h, ky*h, kz*h) at that level's grid spacing h
